q1.question: Why accept crypto on a website?
q1.answer: Crypto payments open sales to customers worldwide with no chargebacks and instant confirmations.

q2.question: How fast can I connect?
q2.answer: Register, verify the business and get API keys. We can issue a ready checkout page without development.

q3.question: How conversion and payouts work?
q3.answer: We lock the rate at payment time, keep funds in cold wallets and withdraw to stables or fiat on your schedule.
